prior_negative.rule: No retuning, replay or carrying over consumed 887xxx, 888xxx, 889xxx cohorts.

hypothesis: Without law labels, a protected three-slot operator-association bank will preserve old A/B associations, detect causal contradiction, and reuse component operators when learning unseen C/D structural compositions; on held-out goals and interventions it will beat strongest matched nonprivileged conventional learner at equal observation/action budgets and bounded compute.

candidate.name: ProtectedOperatorBank
candidate.grammar: For EACH output mediator, exactly nine two-input hypotheses: XOR/AND/OR over all unordered pairs of x0,x1,x2; independent per mediator. This finite grammar is public also to all fair symbolic controls.
candidate.decision: All learned methods use the same deterministic two-step plan search (one-step rollout followed by a second intervention); tie smallest action index; compare no-op/STOP when valid. Any model may update on a publicly observed first intervention consequence; never use ground-truth law.
candidate.learning: After each pair of common observations, compare average predictive log likelihood of active and protected slots (prior evidence only); switch when other slot advantage >=ln4, or allocate novel slot when active poorly predicts batch versus uniform fair-coin by ln4 and room exists; otherwise update active. Inactive slot counts/data immutable. Each slot assigns posterior over finite grammar from its own public evidence with Bernoulli .9/.1 error likelihood. Operator reuse prior computed only from previously observed protected slot evidence and never simulator labels.
candidate.cold: Byte-exact canonical JSON checkpoint of all slot IDs/data/scratch/active counters. Restore independent forks without editing original saved snapshot.
candidate.ablation: same candidate max_slots=1 and no operator prior reuse, other code identical
candidate.information: Only public x, mediators, goal and reward after actual actions; NEVER law identifier, source law formula, unseen candidate reward, fork label, privileged oracle, or science seed.

matched_conventional_controls.symbolic_all: Equal published nine-operator grammar and likelihood, all public observations pooled, no protected bank; same shared planner.
matched_conventional_controls.symbolic_recent8: Same grammar posterior over most recent 8 observed public states; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.symbolic_recent16: Same grammar posterior over most recent 16 observations; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.tabular_recent16: Conventional Beta(1,1) per full 3-bit x per output, recent 16 observations; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.tabular_all: Conventional Beta(1,1) per full 3-bit x per output, all observations; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.logistic_interactions: Conventional logistic per output with intercept + x0,x1,x2 + x0x1,x0x2,x1x2 + x0x1x2, full-batch 1200 epochs, learning rate 0.20, L2 0.01; fit on common evidence after any update; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.symbolic_bank: Conventional two-slot finite-grammar version-space Bayesian change-point comparator (not identical to candidate): hazard 1/12, separate history/active segment, no archived operator prior; same planner.
matched_conventional_controls.reactive: public-input-only fixed deterministic intervention, negative diagnostic.
matched_conventional_controls.oracle: Privileged actual-law two-step exhaustive planner, only diagnostic, excluded from baseline comparison.

common_protocol.train: 32 public action-consequence observations under A and 32 under B (fixed common x/goal/actions per world, same ordered observations for all models), no boundary labels; each observed pre-state and post-state can be supplied, and no extra interventions by candidates.
common_protocol.checkpoint: Immediately after B, freeze state by canonical JSON for each method, then cold restore for A_returns, B_continues, unfamiliar_C, unfamiliar_D independently.
common_protocol.challenge: For each branch, N public exogenous do-interventions (N=0,2,4,8) on independent states, action and goal determined by hash of world/phase/index, same actual public outcomes for every method. No privileged law label.
common_protocol.evaluate: At N=2 and 4 primary, evaluate on 16 disjoint (x,goal) contexts per world using the public initial state then up to 2 sequential public actions with feedback; held-out context hash namespace; one model's actions do not leak to another. Learners all have equal two-action allowance and same initial public observation. No counterfactual training data.
common_protocol.no_label: No label, hidden law, objective outcome of unchosen action or target-regime identity is ever provided. At N=0, model states before seeing the test context must be identical across forks; once initial x/output is observed, legal difference allowed.
common_protocol.pairing: Whole WORLD is resampling unit; same contexts/goals across methods and same actual law within condition, but action-contingent public observations can legitimately differ.
common_protocol.cold_retention: After evaluating each independent continuation, re-restore frozen after-B original A/B checkpoint and test A/B retention on a separate held-out diagnostic; verify preserved IDs/unchanged inactive data.
common_protocol.negative: 32 independent NEGATIVE worlds with challenge public-feedback order shuffled at equal observation count; candidate vs shuffled association accuracy and regret.
common_protocol.fair_compute: Walltime update/inference, total process walltime, stored bytes, peak memory; no privileged oracle in fastest matched baseline.

primary_metric.transfer: Mean reward over unfamiliar C and D combined at N2/N4, per-world paired differences candidate minus best matched conventional learner; bootstrap 2048 draws resampling whole world ID, seed 39092; baseline chosen by highest own transfer average (strongest-control selection is conservative, not corrected multiple comparison).
primary_metric.secondary: Return-A recall, B hold nondegradation, original slot preservation/retrieval, one-slot ablation, shuffled negative, each actual policy two-action safety, compute and memory.
primary_metric.minimum_benchmark_headroom: Known-law oracle over strongest matched learner on unfamiliar transfer N2/N4 >=0.15 reward with bootstrap CI lower >0, and matched learner not already >=95% of possible terminal reward. Otherwise HEADROOM_INADEQUATE_NO_PROMOTION.
primary_metric.candidate_superiority: candidate minus strongest >=+0.08 reward with paired bootstrap 95% lower>0; candidate vs one_slot >=+0.05 with lower>0; unfamiliar goal correctness >=0.80; B-hold candidate minus strongest >=-0.02; return-A candidate minus strongest >=-0.02; original A-slot preservation/retrieval >=0.60; negative proper minus shuffled gain >=0.10 CI lower>0; compute <=2x fastest matched nonoracle; byte-exact cold checkpoints; no information leaks.

future_science.mechanical_seed_policy: Pre-science tests use only explicit synthetic handcrafted cases, never call world generator on 991xxx/992xxx/993xxx.

engineering_exit: Exact pinned benchmark SHA, prereg blob unchanged, finite source-only controls and negative tests, full original 54/54 repository suite plus dedicated focused tests Linux and Windows on identical final candidate SHA; final code atlas current; source tree clean.
